Acme Corporation Global Mobility Policy v3.2
Effective 2026-01-01

1. Scope
This policy covers permanent and long-term assignments for employees in bands B1, B2, B3, and B4.

2. Eligibility
Available to employees on Permanent and Long-Term assignment types with a minimum contract of 12 months.

6.1 Temporary housing
Acme will cover temporary housing for up to 60 days, capped at USD 6000.

6.2 Rental deposit
Rental deposit support of up to 2 months of agreed monthly rent.

6.3 Shipment of household goods
Shipment allowance up to 40 cubic feet for B1-B2 bands. B3-B4 bands receive up to 60 cubic feet.

6.4 Education support
Education support: tuition assistance up to USD 15000 per child per school year for international schools.

6.5 Visa support
Visa and immigration support is fully covered including work permit and residence permit applications.

6.6 Travel to host location
One round-trip airfare for the employee and immediate family to the host location.

6.7 Settling-in allowance
Settling-in allowance of EUR 2500 paid one time upon arrival.

6.8 Tax assistance
Tax equalization and tax assistance fully provided for the duration of the assignment.

6.9 Spousal support
Spousal support: up to USD 3000 for partner support, job-search assistance and language training.

6.10 Language training
Language and cultural training provided for the employee and spouse, up to 80 hours total.

6.11 Repatriation
Return shipment and return travel covered on assignment completion.
